Rosa Gutierrez  
📍 Berlin, Germany | 📧 rosa.gutierrez@cybershield.com | 📞 +49 123 456 789  
---  
A seasoned cybersecurity professional with a decade of experience in designing and implementing robust security frameworks. Specialized in aligning technical solutions with regulatory standards, optimizing incident response, and mentoring teams to enhance security maturity. My work bridges operational security practices with strategic compliance, ensuring systems are resilient against evolving threats.  

At CyberShield Solutions, I led the development of a centralized security operations center, integrating SIEM tools to reduce incident response time by 30%. This involved configuring Splunk and ELK Stack to correlate log data, enabling proactive threat detection. I also spearheaded the transition to SOC2 compliance, coordinating cross-functional teams to document controls and audit trails, which streamlined third-party verification processes. My role extended to architecting IAM solutions that balanced accessibility with risk mitigation, supporting the company’s expansion into EU markets.  

Previously, at GlobalSecure Inc., I designed a vulnerability management program that prioritized critical assets, reducing high-severity vulnerabilities by 40% within two years. This included automating scan schedules and integrating with ticketing systems to ensure timely remediation. I also conducted regular security audits, identifying configuration gaps in cloud environments that saved the company an estimated €150k in potential breach costs. My work on threat modeling for a SaaS platform informed architectural decisions that minimized attack surfaces, earning recognition in internal security reviews.  

Technical expertise spans penetration testing, where I routinely identified zero-day vulnerabilities in legacy systems, and security auditing, which I embedded into quarterly assessments to ensure policy adherence. Application security is central to my practice, with a focus on OWASP guidelines shaping secure coding standards across teams. I’ve mentored junior engineers in secure design patterns and contributed to open-source tools for static code analysis.  

**Projects**  
- **SIEM Integration at CyberShield**: Redesigned log management workflows, improving incident correlation accuracy by 25% and reducing false positives.  
- **GDPR Compliance Framework**: Developed a data governance model that aligned with EU regulations, enabling seamless data processing across 12 countries.  
- **Zero Trust Architecture Pilot**: Designed an IAM solution that reduced unauthorized access attempts by 60% through granular role-based controls.  
- **Threat Intelligence Pipeline**: Built a system to aggregate and analyze external threat feeds, enhancing proactive defense capabilities against ransomware campaigns.
